findings.claim: The selected-node pane applies the bank-aware estimate (ResearchSnapshot.TurnsOf to InfoQuery.ResearchTurns) to LOCKED and PARTIAL civics as well. The engine cannot spend the bank on such a node. With destination routing (as shipped), ordering it makes it a destination and the Civics lane funds its route prerequisites first, one civic per End Turn because overflow is off. So the pane shows values the engine cannot reach. 15 locked civics on the stepped world read '~1 turns at the current rate', and no locked node can complete in 1 End Turn. This contradicts the lane's account that the estimate 'follows the engine's spending order' and, for a civic not being funded, 'is what happens once that civic is ordered' (H-RT §8; fixes §0 and §3.3). It also falls short of the brief (2c), which asked the estimate to account for 'which civic it funds'. The case is undisclosed and untested. It is display-only, and the pre-change pane was not engine-accurate for locked civics either (gift_exchange showed ~11 against the engine's 2). So it is an unaddressed case plus an overclaim, not a clear accuracy regression.
